claimBoundaries.rule: Do not strengthen a source claim in any language. Contextual negative statements may mention a forbidden claim without asserting it; automated word filters are not linguistic acceptance.

localeStyle.en: Clear U.S. field English, distinguish nouns/actions and visible observation from claims.
localeStyle.es: U.S./Latin-American field Spanish; record regional alternatives and test comprehension across Hispanic backgrounds.
localeStyle.zh-Hans: Simplified Chinese terminology and script; independently review field meaning.
localeStyle.zh-Hant: Traditional Chinese terminology and script; independently review field meaning, not automatic script conversion.
localeStyle.vi: Preserve Vietnamese diacritics; review natural field instructions and destructive states.
localeStyle.ko: Consistent Korean field terminology and action/register choices; review natural controls and reports.

limitations: No professional, independent, native or bilingual review receipt is fabricated.
No locale terms, localized catalog release or future vertical is activated by this foundation.
